text:
Buffalo comes in off a 2-0 win at SJS, a game that snapped a three-game winless run (0-1-2) and a shutout for Colten Ellis. This is game three of a four-game road trip for the Sabres, who are missing Jiri Kulich, Sam Carrick and Matt Grzelcyk. Anaheim is coming off a 6-5 overtime loss to VAN after blowing a three-goal lead, and the Ducks are 1-3-1 in their last five without Ryan Poehling and Pavel Mintyukov. With Poehling out, Roger McQueen has moved in beside Nesterenko and Killorn. Olen Zellweger also returns to Anaheim for the first time since leaving the Ducks.

The Sabres have been better than their record. They hold 52% of the five-on-five expected goals (the quality of chances), against 44% for the Ducks, and Buffalo's finishing has cost it about seven goals. Anaheim takes 4.8 penalties a game, which keeps feeding opponents' power plays. In net, projected starters Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen (-3.5 goals saved above expected) and Lukas Dostal (+0.3) are both struggling to stop pucks, though Luukkonen was +9.1 last season.

Tage Thompson (68% for a point, top power play) and Jack Quinn (64%) lead Buffalo's list. For Anaheim, Cutter Gauthier has no goals in nine games on 3.2 expected goals, and we put him at 34% to score. Leo Carlsson is 71% for a point. As our under-the-radar pick, Noah Ostlund is at 50% for a point, above his usual pace, since the Ducks give up the third-most expected goals per 60. He's a player to watch, not a lock.
